recipe.status: Adapted editorial recipe; cook and taste before publishing it as tested. Source credit below.
ingredients: 1 tbsp fish sauce, optional; check dietary needs
method: Preheat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). In one oven-safe dish, stir red curry paste, garlic, ginger, coconut milk and fish sauce until smooth.
Add broccoli and spinach, then arrange frozen dumplings partially in the sauce.
Bake for about 20 minutes, or until dumplings are cooked through and lightly golden. Check the dumpling package and extend cooking if needed.
Finish with chili crisp, coriander and lime. Serve hot.
